rationale: The answer correctly identifies the supported primary cause: Cobra adds the top-level `--version` flag only when the root command’s `Version` field is set. This is directly supported by `site/content/user_guide.md:590-592` and by the preserved `command.go:1202-1204` evidence stating that initialization does nothing when `c.Version` is empty. The candidate does not incorrectly claim that a non-empty version is sufficient in every case, so omission of the separate preexisting-`version`-flag condition does not make this direct answer incorrect.
